reason: Stream B (F8, F9, F10) changes the shared ContextCompactor in context.py (prompt v2 with short source ids and an answer limit, summary allowance floor, Core-owned objective, lenient parsing, citation/identifier/ID checks, repair then salvage of cut-off or invalid answers, deterministic extractive fallback, lossless union and guarded model roll-ups, importance-weighted trimming, ContextSegment leaf reuse, cache-aware usage sums), ContextMemory/ContextSnapshot/ContextSegment in domain.py (new defaulted fields and entity), ContextStatus.quality (chat context_status and the run context route), cascade deletion of segments in storage.py, export provider references and CUSTOM_RESOURCES classification. Selected: the compactor tests (test_context); Stream A's assembly tests, which drive compaction through _model_context and whose fixture and objective check this PR adjusts; test_chat and test_chat_api (compaction charging, degraded chat continuation, context and run context endpoints, runtime switch preflight, context recovery); every file that calls the compactor directly or asserts compactor requests, schema or snapshots (chat leftovers, deepseek/glm compat, turn outcome history repair replay, history content fidelity, preflight latency, project instructions, model output budget, prompt cache, inference timeouts compaction node); mission compaction (orchestration); entity registration and deletion (domain, generic CRUD exposure, storage, exporter); the memory schema on OpenAI-compatible and Responses adapters; conversation search, passage retrieval and cross-turn tool memory (streams R and C1), which build or serve compaction snapshots. Counts from pytest --collect-only.
exclusions: No frontend, native or Playwright tests: no UI, Rust or visible behavior change. The context API gains defaulted fields (ContextStatus.quality; snapshot quality, dropped_items, segment_count, reused_segments; memory lists user_requests, current_state, attempts, references) that the current UI ignores; the Working context panel that shows them is the later mockup-gated UI stream. Provider adapter internals are unchanged; only their handling of the compactor schema is covered. Harness runtimes own their context and never call the compactor. Real-Core evidence (OpenRouter deepseek/deepseek-v4.1-flash on a 6,000-token window, two compactions, leaf reuse, provider cache hits) is recorded in the PR body. No full suite.
